summary: Seven production browser checks pass locally and in Linux Node 22 CI with mock agents; PR #11 awaits review/merge. Clean-install build, 105 Node tests, 16 queue tests and 42 simulator checks pass. Persistence and authentication executors are working on isolated modules. Earlier paid-model and hosting evidence retains its original Sep 8 scope; M1–M4 remain incomplete.

items.title: Five-agent console
items.notes: React dashboard, orchestration, streaming, virtual workspace and human approval.

items.title: Runtime correctness
items.notes: Revision-bound evidence, permissions, cancellation, restart isolation and reported usage.

items.title: OpenAI Responses provider
items.notes: Opt-in provider; validated calls, continuation and usage. All workspace operations remain simulated.

items.title: Regression suite and CI
items.notes: Fresh local and Linux Node 22 CI clean install, production build/typechecks, 105 Node tests and 42 simulator checks pass at dc89a1d. The prior local Vite stall was not reproduced in the isolated verification checkout. PR #11 remains unmerged.

items.title: Offline browser acceptance
items.notes: Seven automated Chromium checks pass locally and in Linux CI against production code with mock agents, including explicit approval to Done, real SSE reconnection/deduplication, Snapshot JSON/error retry and progress-page views. PR #11 awaits review/merge; no paid calls.

items.title: Visual progress document and controls
items.notes: PRs #5–7 delivered standalone status, theme and table controls. Sep 8 browser CI proposal refresh records pending merge and actual executor registrations; screenshots, pagination and print are checked at desktop/mobile/ultrawide.

items.title: Roadmap and status reconciliation
items.notes: Roadmap and ledger distinguish the useful paid probe, Snapshot export and external executor coordination from unfinished M1–M4 product milestones.

items.title: Real model acceptance runner
items.notes: Preflight and explicit two-run execution, gate validation, budget stops, cancellation and private reports. Twelve offline regressions pass; live acceptance remains pending.

items.title: Useful paid model proposal
items.notes: One gpt-5.6-sol request proposed the Snapshot feature for $0.113582 against a $0.50 allowance. No retries. Not full M1 acceptance.

items.title: Current run Snapshot export
items.notes: Fresh JSON download, all public log lines, no run mutation, duplicate protection, timeout and visible errors. Unit, CI production build and mock browser checks pass.

items.title: Durable executor communication queue
items.notes: Private SQLite assignments, leases, immutable reports/decisions and restart cursor. Sixteen offline tests pass, including two separate worker processes. Product runtime remains unchanged.

items.title: Registered executor wakeup acceptance
items.notes: Local queue confirms persistence/authentication initial reports and claimed follow-up module tasks. Verification is registered as a local Codex subagent. Claude cloud review reported but could not access the Mac-local queue; no automatic external launcher or cloud bridge is claimed. End-to-end delivery acceptance remains separate.

items.title: Provider access and spending limits
items.notes: Provider access confirmed Sep 8 with one authorized gpt-5.6-sol request at $0.113582. Further runs require explicit budgets and the intended runner environment; the single-call allowance does not authorize them.

items.title: Hosting decision
items.notes: Sep 8: GitHub returned no deployment records. Historical Vercel/provider state remains unverified; this does not prove no hosting exists.

items.title: Real model acceptance
items.notes: Runner verified offline and one useful paid proposal completed. Two consecutive five-agent OpenAI passes remain pending explicit budgets and runner configuration.

items.title: Budget ceiling assurance
items.notes: Reported usage enforcement exists; in-flight calls can overshoot and missing usage remains unknown.

items.title: Persistent runs and restart recovery
items.notes: Persistence executor has claimed its isolated storage-module implementation after design review. Product wiring, historical UI and crash/recovery acceptance are pending; current main still stores runs in memory.

items.title: API authentication
items.notes: Authentication executor has claimed its isolated session/auth-module implementation after design review. API/SSE wiring and browser authentication acceptance are pending; current main remains unauthenticated.

items.title: Run history and transcript export
items.notes: Historical run API, picker and historical transcript exports depend on persistent storage. Current-run Snapshot download is delivered separately.

items.title: Browser regression tests in CI
items.notes: PR #11 adds seven Chromium regressions to the existing PR/main gate; Linux Node 22 CI run 34223758973 passes at dc89a1d. Browser artifacts expire Sep 22 unless removed earlier. Coordinator review and merge are pending; auth/history/recovery coverage is still pending.

items.title: Dashboard controls and fidelity
items.notes: Snapshot is wired and browser verified. Reassign, activity footer and remaining fidelity checklist are still outstanding.

items.title: Real repository workspace
items.notes: Isolated files, restricted commands, Git operations, configurable goals and GitHub PR integration.

items.title: Real feature delivery acceptance
items.notes: Prepare sandbox; prove real tests, agent PR, approval hold and human-approved merge.

items.title: Packaging and deployment
items.notes: Container/runbook, persistent storage, secrets, HTTPS and selected host.

items.title: Remote and phone acceptance
items.notes: Verify authenticated deployed dashboard, mock and budgeted real runs; document deployment.
